# Copilot Customization Scaffold

This folder defines project-level Copilot customizations.

## Structure

- agents: specialized custom agents
- instructions: file-scoped coding guidance
- skills: reusable multi-step task playbooks
- prompts: reusable focused prompts
- hooks: optional automation and policy hooks

## Recommended Usage

1. Start in the Orchestrator agent for any medium or large task.
2. Hand off to specialists for implementation.
3. Use QA reviewer before marking a wave complete.
